brief: A separately registered triangular Emirates tower with three open base piers, eight-storey glass drum, bowed outer curtain wall, horizontal ribbon facades, copper-glass beacon, slit-window upper floors and sloping glazed roof with a rectangular pinnacle.

sourceFacts.materials: Silver aluminium panels with silver/copper reflective glass; granite base
sourceFacts.dimensionalSource: Architect-contributed plans, sections and commentary in The Architecture of the United Arab Emirates, printed64–78; contractor Multiplex whole-metre height309 for hotel and354 for office; book355 office.

reconstruction.base: Three full-depth triangular piers flank an independently enclosed eight-floor circular drum. Tower-specific canopy, revolving-door volumes and a small arrival apron are modeled; the shared shopping/parking podium is excluded to avoid overlapping assets.
reconstruction.facade: Two horizontal ribbon facades have separate recessed glazing, silver spandrels and outward projecting sills. The broad outer facade bows as a physical cylinder segment, rather than a flat texture. Upper narrow windows and copper-glass cylindrical beacon are separate geometry.
reconstruction.roof: Two metal-clad gables enclose a diagonal-framed triangular glass roof. Rectangular two-stage mast and small maintenance arms retain a distinctive silhouette.

limitations: The unchanged original buildEmirates office recipe reproduces343268triangles/31623800bytes exactly. Reviewed source retains the55.5m equilateral shaft, three open triangular piers around an eight-floor circular drum,40ribbon floor datums, physically bowed outer curtain wall, recessed ribbons and projecting sills, five tall crown slits per side, copper-tinted cylindrical beacon, sloping glass roof between two metal gables, two-stage rectangular mast to355m and attached arrival canopy/apron with three reconstructed revolving-door casings. Repeated2cm panel-joint beams, tiny mast joints and per-panel face subdivisions are omitted; continuous shared stainless panels replace painted-metal/stainless duplicate surface groups. Shared stainless tinted silver approximates aluminium, and opaque glass approximates reflective vision glass and the real clear drum. Skyline has sparse five-floor ribbons, six-segment bow, one-floor coarse drum, five crown slits and triangular roof/mast; canopy/apron, door casings, fine curtain mullions, beacon frame bands and maintenance arms are omitted. District restores canopy/apron/doors, four drum belts, three-floor ribbons, twelve-segment bow and sparse diagonal roof grid. Street restores every floor datum, eight drum belts, facade mullions, denser bow/roof sampling, slits, sill projections and maintenance arms. Close-up adds dense drum glazing, beacon bands and fine roof grid. Original intermediate base/crown datums, bow/radius, panel/mullion pitches and canopy/door dimensions remain photo reconstructions; only overall published height, side, floor-to-floor pitch and major forms/counts are primary. Current architect NORR rounds total height360m and counts52office floors; contractor gives354m/54floor office, while architect-contributed book uses355m/54. Selected original355m is retained; no forced agreement is claimed. Common retail complex, interiors, landscaping and neighboring Museum of the Future are excluded. Actual physical-device/dense-city timings and surveyed entrance/curb fit remain unmeasured.

geographic.orientationConfidence: fresh tenant coordinates, labelled owner plan, independent mapped triangle and primary roof photos
geographic.notes: Fresh2026-10-10 office-tenant Servcorp structured coordinates[55.283546,25.21768] independently identify the eastern shaft. The labelled2018 owner terrace plan distinguishes office/east and hotel/west, corroborated by the architect-contributed book site plan printed67 and completed photos. Eastern way393391115 retains conflicting hotel Q1049027/name:en tags; raw tags are preserved and explicit Q845182 office identity override is retained. Fresh raw footprint is exact against the independent original source-local baseline, including its collinear extra vertex; projection differs by under1mm. Three true triangle vertices retain centroid[55.28363353333333,25.2176177] and directed heading2.6255014113716246, with native+X toward the west-northwest high roof/apex/mast and-X toward the outer east-southeast glass lobby. Native+Z points north-northeast. The published55.5m equilateral side governs geometry over the approximate mapped54m side; accept1m principal-triangle/1degree bearing allowance. The original reconstructed bowed outer curtain wall projects5.5m beyond its straight rear chord, and entrance canopy/apron project farther; these are declared attached exterior elements, not surveyed raw footprint matches. Neither fresh mapped entrance belongs to this tower. GroundY0 is an unsurveyed reconstructed entrance datum; shared retail/parking podium and the other tower are excluded. No footprint replacement.
